Overview.Name: Rajesh Patibandla
Overview.Goal: Maintain weight while improving energy, digestion, and day-to-day steadiness. Meals kept clean, simple, and flexible for shift timings.

Meal_1: 2–3 whole eggs or 120g paneer cooked in ghee
OR One small bowl rice + Cooked vegetables + One bowl curd
Meal_2: 150g paneer or homemade curd as the protein base
OR One bowl rice with a mix of cooked vegetables
OR 2 boiled eggs if needed for fullness
Snack_Optional_If_Hungry: OR Puffed rice with onion and salt
OR Fruit like banana, apple or papaya

Notes_and_Tips: Since you crave tasty food, focus on making meals flavourful without excess oil. Use ghee, pepper, ginger, garlic, and fresh herbs.
Keep vegetables simple and cooked well; avoid overuse of masala to prevent overeating triggers.
Shift work can affect hunger patterns. Stick to two fixed meals even if timings vary.
Include curd often to keep digestion steady and improve gut comfort.
Avoid bakery items, deep fried foods, and snacks with seed oils.
If you feel low energy, increase protein slightly instead of increasing rice.
Take a 10 minute walk after each meal to maintain energy and support mental clarity.
Focus on maintaining current weight while improving overall energy and digestive health.
Use ghee as primary cooking fat and avoid seed oils for better nutrition absorption.
